_what_this_is: A template, not a receipt. Every <angle-bracketed> value is a placeholder, which the reader refuses as evidence. Fill it in inside the private environment, keep it there, and validate it with 'py -3.10 -m harness.commands.execution_receipt'. The validator refuses a receipt stored inside this repository.
authored_on: <the date it was filled in, YYYY-MM-DD>
purpose: <the run this receipt is readiness evidence for>

processing_route.authority: <the private environment's own rule that permits this processing, named>
processing_route.processing: <what that rule permits to be sent to the provider>
processing_route.export: <what that rule permits to leave the environment>

cli_version.executable: <the resolved path of the claude executable>

model_identity.note: A declared identifier. The provider attests nothing on this transport.

effective_settings.name: working_directory
effective_settings.value: <the fresh directory the child runs in>

effective_settings.name: temperature
effective_settings.transport_evidence: the claude CLI takes no temperature argument, so the pinned value reaches no provider; robustness comes from majority voting over N samples

effective_settings.name: max_tokens
effective_settings.transport_evidence: the judge's limit is not rendered; the child's ceiling is the transport's own CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS value

argv: <every argument as handed to the operating system, one per entry>

evidence: <how the blindness was verified: the tests read, the argv inspected, the directory listed>

checkpoint.path: <where the run will write its checkpoint, under the private clone>

preflight.report_path: <the preflight report, absolute or relative to this receipt>
preflight.import_manifest_sha256: <its sha256, as the preflight pinned it>
